note: faiblesse significative non corrigée au 30 septembre 2026 : contrôles généraux informatiques (accès des utilisateurs à certaines applications financières), relevée au 10-K de l'exercice 2026 ; une seule faiblesse restante
quote: Based upon this evaluation, our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective at the reasonable assurance level as of September 30, 2026 due to the material weakness in our internal control over financial reporting, described below, that were previously identified in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 filed on August 31, 2026.
